921a04cd-c27a-f111-ab0f-000d3a14673b.longDescription: Focus, Trust, and Follow is a collection of experiences I had that made God real to me. I was able to learn that God will use the quietness of a shy child, the boldness of a defiant preteen, and even math equations that don’t make sense to make His word plain. In each individual devotion, I was reminded to either Focus on God, Trust Him and what He was telling me to do, and finally to Follow Him with reckless abandon. These are the 3 steps that God gave to me a few years ago to keep me on track with Him. Because of He is a merciful God, He offers me the opportunity to start over at which ever step I may be lacking. Whether I have lost focus, struggling with trust, or refusing to follow His direction I always have another chance. With that being said, this book certainly can be read in the order it is written but also allows the reader to go straight to the devotion that encourages them the most.

Along with him being there for us, he puts people in our lives to guide, lift our spirits, and be of comfort. Whether it’s family or friends, God is always watching out for us. Her story as a spiritual and birth mother is profound and describes her impact of love and sweet potato pie. Love Lucy will remind you of the mother hero in your life, that person who loves you unconditionally, and how their quiet, powerful presence impacts your journey every day.

7a064bcd-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.longDescription:
What is faith—really? Is it belief, confidence, doctrine, spiritual effort, or something more?

In Aligned! Unlocking the DNA of Authentic Faith, veteran minister and missionary Dennis E. Brown challenges common assumptions about faith and invites readers to rediscover it at its most fundamental level. Rather than defining faith by what it produces or how strongly it is held, Brown explores faith as a relational reality—an alignment with the nature, character, and purposes of God.

Rooted in Scripture and shaped by decades of cross-cultural ministry experience, this book traces the essence of faith back to the creation event itself. Brown argues that faith flows from humanity’s unique design: being created in the image of God and invited into relationship with Him. From this foundation, faith becomes not a tool to wield or a force to master, but a lived experience that shapes identity, perspective, and daily life.

Through thoughtful teaching, practical insights, and memorable illustrations, Aligned! addresses questions such as:
	•	What distinguishes authentic faith from cultural or religious substitutes?
	•	How does faith function in real life, especially in times of struggle and uncertainty?
	•	Why is relationship—not performance—the true source of spiritual growth?

Written for thoughtful Christians, ministry leaders, and anyone seeking clarity about faith, Aligned! is well suited for individual reading, small-group discussion, and church or library collections. It offers a compelling vision of faith as alignment with God—simple in essence, profound in impact, and transformative in practice.
7a064bcd-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.shortDescription: Aligned! explores faith at its core, revealing authentic faith as a lived relationship with God. Through Scripture and reflection, Dennis E. Brown invites readers to discover faith as alignment with God’s nature rather than mere belief.

7b064bcd-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.longDescription:
Tabby has survived heartbreak before—but this time, she’s determined not just to survive, but to reclaim her happiness.

Recently divorced and emotionally guarded, Tabby is no stranger to loss, betrayal, or disappointment. When a younger, magnetic man enters her life, he awakens a passion she thought she had buried for good. Their connection is intense, intoxicating, and deeply sensual—offering Tabby a glimpse of the joy she’s been craving.

But desire has consequences. As love, lust, and emotional baggage collide, Tabby finds herself navigating toxic patterns, blurred boundaries, and painful self-realizations. The more she gives of herself, the more she must confront the truth about who she is, what she deserves, and whether love should come at the cost of her peace.

Almost Happy: The Chronicles of Tabby is a bold, erotic, and emotionally resonant novel that explores modern relationships, Black female identity, and the complicated journey toward self-love. With unflinching honesty and sensual intensity, Jaylonna Stevette delivers a story about desire, healing, and the courage it takes to stop settling for “almost” and start choosing yourself.

Intended for mature readers (18+).
7b064bcd-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.shortDescription: Tabby thought she was getting back to happy—until love pulled her into desire, betrayal, and self-reckoning. Almost Happy is a raw, sensual journey through heartbreak, healing, and the cost of choosing love again.

Through daily prayers and reflections, Baker explores how sincere prayer can actualize God's promises and protect against the devil's wiles. The book combines personal stories, biblical teachings, and practical advice, focusing on virtues like patience, purpose, and self-control. Baker's commitment to standing on Nehemiah’s wall and her persistence in praying for God’s people are central themes, highlighting the potential of steadfast prayer to bear fruit in one's spiritual journey. Lady Daphanny’s Altar is an ideal guide for anyone seeking to deepen their faith through prayer and live a Christ-centered life, making it a valuable tool for both personal growth and group study.

They have faced the barriers you are facing and come out on the other side. f0084bcd-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.longDescription: Pieces of Me All Over the Place is a poetic biography reflecting many different pieces of Ashanti’s life. This book takes you on a roller coaster ride of many twists and turns. It covers such topics as self-esteem, domestic violence, love, heartbreak, prayers, self-worth, social injustice, and the demise of African-Americans. Poems such as Am I Good Enough and Broken Vessel dive into self-esteem as Ashanti questions her own self-worth in relationships. Teach Me is Ashanti’s personal prayer to God as she seeks to learn His ways and acknowledges that her own free-will tends to get her off track. Finally, in the poem No More, Ashanti shares her personal story of enduring and escaping domestic violence. You will experience more pieces of Ashanti’s life and spiritual lessons as you read Pieces of Me all Over the Place.

944b00d4-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.longDescription: The book, “The Journey, ” is titled after my first CD project. It is all about the process I went through from beginning to end to record my first CD. The Inspiration and message behind the music tell the story of why I wrote each song. I opened up about what was going on in my life that contributed to the songs. I share the scriptures that inspired me and the message I wanted to convey to the readers. The book has insight from my music producer about how he approached the task of helping me complete my musical assignment. The title and cover of the book are designed to pique the interest of Gospel/Inspirational music lovers around the world. Each chapter of the book is dedicated to a song from the CD project. In addition, I share stories in the book that gives the reader more insight into who I am. It has always been my desire for people to feel my music and be inspired somehow. Now that is my desire for this book. I want the readers to come away uplifted and encouraged by my writing. As a result of reading this book, I pray that the readers go on their own journeys following the assignment given to them by God.

b34b00d4-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.longDescription:
Girl, Did You Know…? is a deeply personal and faith-centered journey of healing, truth, and restoration. In this compelling and transparent work, Kimberly Reeder invites women into an honest conversation about pain, identity, relationships, and the long-lasting impact of past choices.

Through powerful storytelling and spiritual reflection, the author shares her lived experiences—navigating broken relationships, emotional wounds, and cycles that repeated over time. Rather than masking the past, she brings it into the light, revealing how unresolved pain, misunderstanding, and misplaced beliefs can shape a woman’s life in ways she may not immediately recognize.

This book addresses the deeper realities behind emotional struggles, including the weight of past decisions, the importance of forgiveness, and the process of healing from within. It encourages readers to confront what has been buried, acknowledge patterns that may be holding them back, and begin the work of true restoration.

Grounded in faith, Girl, Did You Know…? emphasizes the importance of understanding one’s identity through a relationship with God. It highlights how spiritual awareness, personal accountability, and intentional growth can lead to lasting transformation. With a balance of vulnerability and guidance, the author speaks directly to women who may feel lost, overlooked, or uncertain about their worth.

This is not a story of perfection—it is a story of process. It reminds readers that healing is layered, growth takes time, and restoration is possible. For women seeking clarity, direction, and a deeper connection to their faith, this book offers both encouragement and a path forward.
b34b00d4-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.shortDescription: A faith-based journey of healing and restoration, Girl, Did You Know…? helps women confront past pain, break destructive cycles, and rediscover their identity through truth, forgiveness, and a deeper relationship with God.

c84b00d4-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.longDescription:
Why do we have to fight for what God has already promised?

In The Fight for the Promiseland: Battle Strategies for Victorious People, Cheryl Cook explores the spiritual paradox of promise and perseverance. If God has declared victory, why must we still endure resistance, doubt, and delay?

Using the biblical story of the children of Israel as a spiritual framework, this faith-centered guide reveals how internal battles—fear, indecision, distraction, and unbelief—often present greater obstacles than external challenges. Through personal reflection, biblical insight, and practical application, Cook offers seven transformative principles designed to help readers grow in clarity, confidence, and spiritual endurance.

This inspirational work invites readers to:
	•	Strengthen their faith in seasons of uncertainty
	•	Make courageous, God-led decisions
	•	Embrace necessary change
	•	Walk boldly toward a God-prepared future

The Promised Land is more than a physical place—it represents purpose, growth, and “something better.” Victory does not come through passivity but through partnership with God, intentional preparation, and steadfast trust.

For anyone longing to move beyond fear and into faith, this book offers encouragement, wisdom, and a reminder that with God, the battle is never fought alone.
c84b00d4-c27a-f111-ab0f-00224820105b.shortDescription: A faith-filled guide to overcoming fear, gaining clarity, and stepping boldly into God’s promises. Through biblical insight and practical encouragement, The Fight for the Promiseland reveals how to fight in faith and walk confidently toward your future.

Every now and then, one need’s the Nudge of God to stay the course to stay led, directed, and guided by God. The Nudge illuminates the word that it will shine like a lamp unto your feet and a light unto your path. Why God’s Nudge? God’s Nudge was written during a worldwide pandemic (Covid-19). Anxiety , depression, sadness, fear, doubt, the spirit of “quit,” and so many other symptomology and emotions were present, which filled many hearts and minds. Because God is our refuge and strength, a present help in trouble, he offers His infallible word to bring comfort and guidance. In reading God’s Nudge, there is fresh Rhema in each chapter providing support to the readers with reflective insight to search the scriptures to gain deeper understanding, knowledge, and life application. God’s Nudge is thought-provoking and enlightening. It will ignite the branches of readers to “level up” in your journey .

Damaged is a compelling urban romance about love, loyalty, and second chances. Mario “Stoney” Johnson is determined to leave behind the life that once defined him, but his past refuses to let him go. Latoya, strong yet guarded, has built walls around her heart after enduring deep emotional pain.

When their worlds collide, the chemistry between them is undeniable. But as their relationship grows, so do the risks. Old enemies, hidden secrets, and unresolved trauma threaten to tear them apart before they have a chance to build something real.

Author Ericka Johnson Settles presents seven thoughtfully designed steps that guide readers through internal exploration, mindset transformation, and purposeful living. Each chapter focuses on a core area of growth, including trusting the process, building self-confidence, understanding the power of words, identifying self-sabotaging behaviors, recalibrating focus, and embracing authenticity.

This book is more than encouragement—it is a practical tool. Readers are invited to reflect, write, and actively engage with the material through affirmations and guided moments of reflection that reinforce accountability and clarity. With a compassionate and relatable voice, the author shares insights drawn from lived experience, offering reassurance that growth is achievable, even when the process feels uncomfortable.

Whether you feel stuck, uncertain, or simply ready for more, 7 Step Jumpstart to Becoming Your Best Self provides a supportive framework to help you move forward with intention. Ideal for individual reading, group study, or personal reflection, this book encourages readers to show up for themselves, live with purpose, and confidently step into who they are becoming.

A Blended Family gently explores the joys and challenges of bringing families together through the voice of TJ, a child learning what it means to belong to a blended family. As his parents unite their households, TJ reflects on the changes, the adjustments, and the emotions that come with becoming a new family.

The story honestly addresses early struggles, especially the strained relationship between his sisters, while showing how consistent love, support, and patience from caring parents help guide the family forward. Over time, misunderstandings soften, bonds grow stronger, and the family learns how to support one another through change.

Written from a child’s point of view, this picture book helps young readers feel seen and understood while encouraging empathy and emotional growth. With a faith-inspired message rooted in love, A Blended Family offers reassurance to children navigating family transitions and celebrates the power of unity, compassion, and Godly love within the home.

928904ca-c27a-f111-ab0f-6045bdd69738.longDescription:
Every believer will face trouble—but not every believer knows how to respond to it biblically. In Biblical Prescriptions for Life’s Troubles, Terry Stephens offers a scripturally grounded framework for understanding adversity and responding with spiritual wisdom rather than fear, confusion, or frustration.

Using the metaphor of medicine and diagnosis, Stephens identifies six distinct types of trouble found throughout Scripture: internal conflict, people trouble, personal principle trouble, demonic resistance, bad trouble that God allows, and good trouble that advances God’s purposes. Through careful biblical exposition and practical teaching, he explains that not all trouble is the same—and therefore not all responses should be the same.

Rather than promoting escape-based faith, this book emphasizes endurance, discernment, and obedience. Readers are guided to activate biblical tools such as peace, praise, forgiveness, humility, prayer, and thanksgiving—what the author calls “Kingdom equipment”—to navigate seasons of adversity with spiritual maturity. Drawing from the lives of figures such as Job, Joseph, Daniel, Moses, and the Hebrew boys, Stephens shows how God works both in trouble and through it.

Written for pastors, ministry leaders, and everyday believers alike, Biblical Prescriptions for Life’s Troubles encourages readers to stop misdiagnosing their struggles and start responding with biblical clarity. The result is not only survival through trouble, but spiritual growth, deeper faith, and alignment with God’s purposes in every season of life.
928904ca-c27a-f111-ab0f-6045bdd69738.shortDescription: Life brings trouble—but Scripture brings answers. Biblical Prescriptions for Life’s Troubles equips believers with biblical insight and spiritual tools to respond to adversity with faith, peace, and perseverance.`

60137ed6-c27a-f111-ab0f-6045bdd69738.longDescription:
"Taylor Made: My Life, My Story" is an autobiographical exploration of Dr. Will Harris's remarkable journey through life, music, and faith. Born and raised in the small yet vibrant town of Taylor, Mississippi, Dr. Harris's narrative captures the essence of a soul nurtured by gospel music and tested by life's numerous trials. From his early days playing the piano in church to his pivotal role as a Minister of Music, this book traces his ascent against a backdrop of personal and familial challenges, including growing up with parents who battled mental illness.

Dr. Harris delves deep into the influences that shaped his career and personal life—from his formidable years under the guidance of community choirs to his academic and spiritual development at Rust College. He shares the profound impact of leading the Baptist Student Union Gospel Choir, which became a cornerstone of his musical and leadership skills. His move to Fayetteville, North Carolina, marks a significant phase where he took on the full-time role of Minister of Music at Lewis Chapel Missionary Baptist Church, further solidifying his impact on the gospel music scene.

The narrative does not shy away from the struggles inherent in balancing a demanding career with personal growth. Dr. Harris discusses the financial and emotional toll of striving for success in the competitive music industry, his eventual realization of the need to recalibrate his dreams, and his strategic steps towards sustainable artistry without compromising his spiritual calling.

"Taylor Made" also highlights Dr. Harris's innovative contributions to music education, illustrating his passion for mentoring young musicians and his visionary approach to music ministry. The memoir is replete with lessons on resilience, the importance of authenticity in one’s craft, and the unyielding power of faith.

Through candid reflections and heartwarming anecdotes, Dr. Will Harris invites readers into the intimate quarters of his life, making "Taylor Made: My Life, My Story" not just a memoir, but a beacon of hope and a testament to the transformative power of music and faith in overcoming life's greatest challenges.
60137ed6-c27a-f111-ab0f-6045bdd69738.shortDescription: "Taylor Made: My Life, My Story" is an evocative autobiography by Dr. Will Harris, chronicling his journey from the small town of Taylor, Mississippi, to becoming a celebrated gospel musician and educator. This deeply personal memoir reveals the challenges and triumphs of Harris’s life, from navigating his early days in a musical but tumultuous family environment to his influential role as a Minister of Music. It delves into his spiritual journey, his professional achievements in the world of gospel music, and his passionate commitment to musical education. Dr. Harris's story is one of faith, resilience, and the redemptive power of music, offering readers a unique glimpse into the life of a man truly "Taylor Made" by his experiences and his faith.

62137ed6-c27a-f111-ab0f-6045bdd69738.longDescription:
The Sun, the Shadow, and the Silence is a deeply intimate debut from poet R. Dorian Night, offering a stunning meditation on love, loss, emotional memory, and healing through language.

Structured in three powerful parts—The Sun, The Shadow, and The Silence—this collection moves from radiant longing to quiet devastation and finally to a reckoning with identity, truth, and resilience. Blending classical influence with contemporary emotion, each poem explores the complexity of human connection with unflinching honesty.

Whether through sonnet-like verse or modern confessionals, Night’s work navigates the sacred and the broken, the idealized and the real. These are poems for those who have loved too hard, survived heartbreak, grieved silently, or searched for meaning in moments of emotional wreckage.

The Sun, the Shadow, and the Silence invites readers to sit with their feelings—not to solve them, but to witness them fully. It is a book to be read slowly, felt deeply, and returned to often.

Perfect for readers of:
– Contemporary literary poetry
– Breakup and recovery literature
– Poets like Ocean Vuong, Rupi Kaur, or Sabrina Benaim
– Anyone who has felt the ache of unspoken words or unresolved love

Sometimes, survival isn’t loud. Sometimes, it’s a whisper in the silence—and a poem that stays.
62137ed6-c27a-f111-ab0f-6045bdd69738.shortDescription: A lyrical journey through love, loss, and longing—this debut poetry collection explores heartbreak, healing, and the quiet truths we dare not say aloud.

66137ed6-c27a-f111-ab0f-6045bdd69738.longDescription:
Your Peace is a Priority: A Devotional Journal is a transformative 30-day devotional designed to help readers rediscover inner peace through the grounding power of scripture, prayer, and self-reflection. Written by Dr. Kiena S. Hughley, a respected spiritual leader and educator, this devotional journal invites individuals to embark on a deeply personal journey toward emotional healing and spiritual renewal—especially in times of uncertainty and transition.

Drawing from biblical wisdom, practical insights, and lived experience, Dr. Hughley gently guides readers through three powerful stages of personal growth: identifying what disrupts their peace, examining their inner life and relationships, and reclaiming God’s promises with clarity and courage. Each day features thoughtfully selected scriptures, daily affirmations, reflection prompts, and open space for prayer, making it ideal for morning quiet time, evening journaling, or group devotionals.

Organized with purpose and intentionality, the journal begins with a section on “Renewing the Mind, Body & Soul in a Time of Uncertainty,” offering actionable strategies for managing stress, creating clarity, and building positive spiritual habits. The midsection explores deeper emotional triggers—including bitterness, grief, and guilt—while encouraging accountability and forgiveness. * Building strong, respectful relationships between pastors and music leaders
* Discovering and developing gifts within the congregation
* Leading musicians, psalmists, and worship teams effectively
* Selecting music that aligns with scripture and supports the church’s vision
* Curating meaningful worship experiences that engage and transform

BEE Careful is a heartwarming children’s picture book that follows three young bees—Brittany, Breauna, and Braden—on an unforgettable journey through the meadow and forest.

One sunny morning, Brittany finds herself sneezing again and again. Concerned, she asks the Queen Bee for help and learns about a special sunflower said to be found somewhere beyond the safety of the hive. With engaging, colorful illustrations and gentle storytelling, BEE Careful emphasizes themes of kindness, teamwork, perseverance, and family support. The story invites young readers to explore nature while learning about empathy and cooperation in a way that feels accessible and reassuring.

Ideal for children ages 4–8, BEE Careful is well suited for read-aloud sessions, classrooms, and library collections. It offers a thoughtful, comforting adventure that encourages children to help others, face fears together, and believe in the strength found in family and friendship.

According to Mark: The Gospel of Jesus Christ Begins is a sincere and faith-filled testimony rooted in Scripture and personal experience. Centered on the first chapter of the Gospel of Mark, this book emphasizes the importance of beginning the Gospel where it truly starts—at the proclamation of Jesus Christ and the call to repentance, baptism, and new life.

Alice V. Pryor shares her own journey of salvation with humility and conviction, recounting her experience of being baptized in water and in the Holy Ghost. Through reflection, testimony, and extensive Scripture references, she explains how the Gospel is not merely a message to be studied, but a life to be lived and a transformation to be experienced.

This book is written not to condemn or judge, but to invite. It speaks directly to sinners, backsliders, and seekers, offering encouragement, clarity, and hope through the power of Jesus Christ. Included are Scripture passages from the Gospels, Acts, Romans, Corinthians, Hebrews, and Jude, reinforcing the biblical foundation of the testimony.

According to Mark also preserves the author’s original handwritten work in an appendix, underscoring the authenticity and legacy of this spiritual message. Written as both a witness and a call to faith, this book is intended to inspire readers to understand the Gospel, receive salvation, and walk in newness of life.

the-never-before-told-story-of-the-gelat.shortDescription: 5 year old Zora is a big helper around the house. One day an act of kindness with helping in the kitchen turns into a messy disaster. However, this girl doesn‛t let anything get in her way. Even though things didn‛t go as planned Zora is determined to find a solution. With the assistance of a close family member, Zora develops a strategy that challenges her to confront her fear and rely on teamwork. She is smart, brave, adventurous, and up for any challenge. Family is everything!

your-brain-has-too-much-what-mommy.longDescription: In "Your Brain Has Too Much What, Mommy?" Essence Unique takes readers on a compelling journey through the eyes of young Ezra as he learns about his mother's chronic illness. This touching tale not only illuminates the challenges of living with a chronic condition but also celebrates the strength of family bonds.

Essence Unique takes readers on a compelling journey through the eyes of young Ezra as he learns about his mother's chronic illness. This touching tale not only illuminates the challenges of living with a chronic condition but also celebrates the strength of family bonds.

alice-pryor.name: Alice Pryor
alice-pryor.biography: She is from Ward, West Virginia but has been residing in Central, Ohio over 50 years. Mrs. Pryor accepted Jesus Christ as her Lord and Savior at a young age. Mrs. Pryor has been called to win souls, spread the Gospel of Jesus Christ, and let others know the importance of being baptized with water and the Holy Ghost.

cheryl-travis.name: Cheryl Travis
cheryl-travis.biography:
Cheryl M. Travis spends her days reviewing and investigating death claims for an insurance company in Columbus, Ohio. Because she loves what she does, Cheryl has over 30 years’ experience communicating and advocating for the sick and grieving families. She is also a strong advocate for the Deaf and hard of hearing that began when her eldest child was diagnosed as profoundly deaf.

Cheryl surrendered her life to Christ in 1989. Her teaching ministry began in 1995 at Higher Ground Always Abounding Assemblies under the leadership of the Beloved and honorable Bishop Sherman S. Watkins.

daphanny-baker.name: Daphanny Baker
daphanny-baker.biography: A Pennsylvania resident, she shares her life with her husband—a Pastor—and their four children. Daphanny holds a B.S. in Criminal Justice, an MBA, and a Master of Divinity. Her diverse career includes serving as an astute corrections officer, supervisor in the juvenile justice system, esteemed Pastor’s wife, and Elder in the Lord’s Church. Her spiritual journey has taken her across the globe, including Europe, as she continues to walk boldly in her God-given assignment.

david-williams.name: David Williams
david-williams.biography:
David A. Williams Jr. has always had a creative and entrepreneurial mind; growing up is what allowed him to become more attached to writing. His relationship with God shows in his work, not neglecting the fact that we are all human. In Words of a Troubled Soul, David mirrors his feelings and takes on life through his work.

This book starts like David’s rough, dark, and hopeless life, and as you continue to read, you’ll notice some helpful sayings and quotes along the way. As you reach the middle and end of the book, you’ll see that his writings become brighter and display hope.

dean-wilson.name: Dean Wilson
dean-wilson.biography:
Dean Duvantie Wilson is a serial entrepreneur and financial coach from Hartford, Ct. He co-founded JAH Financial Services & Real Estate, a business solutions firm, and owns Golden Touch Personal Care and the Josette and Dean Wilson Foundation. Through their foundation, Dean teaches aspiring entrepreneurs and small businesses how to empower others, propelling them toward success and prosperity. Dean is also an author, visionary, and philanthropist who is committed to making a positive impact in the world. With a wealth of experience in Commercial Real Estate, Dean has successfully invested in numerous projects within this domain. His full-service CPA Firm offers a comprehensive range of services, including IRS tax resolution, personal and corporate income tax preparation, estate taxes, payroll, bookkeeping services, business funding, insurance and retirement services, and assistance with US Citizenship and Immigration. Dean's background is quite diverse; he is an expert in CAA Forensic, a certified money broker, and holds licenses as a life and health insurance agent, public notary, 10X trainer, travel agent, and accountant. His impressive skills and knowledge make him an invaluable asset to any business that seeks to grow and achieve financial success.

Dean is driven by an unwavering passion to effect meaningful change in the lives of others. Whether through my philanthropic initiatives, expertise in Commercial Real Estate, or the range of comprehensive services offered by J.A.H. Financial Service & Real Estate. Dean also takes immense pride in being a devoted father to four wonderful children: two delightful little girls and two handsome young men. He feels fortunate to be married to the epitome of selflessness, Mrs. Josette Hill-Wilson, who has been an extraordinary inspiration throughout my life.

diane-johnson.name: Diane Johnson
diane-johnson.biography:
Diane Johnson is a recent retiree of the Defense Finance and Accounting Service Columbus, Ohio where she served 30 years in many positions to include; supervisor, branch chief, division chief and training and procedures specialist. She has many talents and now has time to explore her gifts and express her creative nature. She has always enjoyed writing poetry, song lyrics and short stories.

Diane graduated from Marion-Franklin high school in 1977 and went on to graduate from the Ohio State University in 1982 with a Bachelors of Arts in communication. She also went on to pursue a Masters of Arts from Central Michigan University in 2010. With a thirst for knowledge Diane has also achieved certification as a grantwriter, paralegal and notary public.

donjia-walls.name: Donjia Walls
donjia-walls.biography:
Donjia M. Walls was born in 1990 in Newark, New Jersey. She was raised in East Orange, New Jersey, and later returned to Newark in 2009 at the age of 18. Donjia holds an Associate of Arts in Early Childhood Education, a Bachelor of Arts in Sociology, and a Post-Baccalaureate Certificate in Prejudice Reduction and Teaching the History of the Holocaust.

Donjia is a devoted wife and mother, a Behavior Assistant, an event and wedding coordinator, a youth leader with over ten years of experience, a recording artist, and an author. Her previous work includes The Path 2 Take, a youth and young adult Christian fiction novel.

ericka-johnson-settles.name: Ericka Johnson-Settles
ericka-johnson-settles.biography:
Growing up, Ericka often joined her mother in evangelist ministry by the visitation of homebound members, feeding the less fortunate, and singing to those who listened. Thus, a seed of compassion was planted and began to grow.

Facing and overcoming challenges of childhood trauma, becoming a teenage mother, and a failed marriage, Ericka has been able to use each obstacle as a driving force to become more resilient and serve others.

gloria-patterson.name: Gloria Patterson
gloria-patterson.biography: I enjoy inspiring women to believe in themselves, exercise their faith, and overcome adversity, by shifting their mindset. I am a firm believer in whatever the mind can perceive it can achieve. Reading motivational books inspires me to lead and mentor others to success. Stay afloat by quoting the promises of God.

jaylonna-stevette.name: Jaylonna Stevette
jaylonna-stevette.biography:
Jaylonna Stevette is a writer, speaker, mentor, entertainer, and entrepreneur who transitioned from a six-figure corporate America salary to guiding others in fulfilling their life’s work. A spiritualist at heart, Jaylonna believes we possess the power within to dramatically change our circumstances. Described as smart, fierce, sexy, and in control, she is an executor who gets things done. Raised by a single mother of four, Jaylonna understands the challenges of single motherhood and the complexities of life in such circumstances.

Jaylonna’s childhood was marked by experiences that deeply influenced her, with writing and entertainment as safe outlets for expression. Her stories, rooted in real-life themes, resonate with readers. Jaylonna’s writing style is diverse, spanning various fiction genres to self-help and personal testimonials, showcasing her ability to tap into different streams of her artistic talent.

juanita-travis.name: Juanita Travis
juanita-travis.biography:
Author Jaunita Travis was born in 1935, in Steubenville Ohio and grew up in Columbus Ohio where the values of faith, family, and community were deeply ingrained. Her Christian faith has been a guiding light throughout her life, influencing her worldview and her writing.

Juanita is blessed with a large and loving family. She and her late husband Daniel Travis have four children. Of those four children she has eleven grandchildren, and eighteen great-grandchildren. Her family has always been her greatest source of joy and inspiration, often finding their way into her poetry.

kimberly-reeder.name: Kimberly Reeder
kimberly-reeder.biography:
Kimberly Reeder is an author, mentor, and healthy hair specialist with more than forty years of experience serving women and families from many walks of life. Known for her commitment to healthy hair and personalized care, she has built lasting relationships with the clients who sit in her chair.

For Kimberly, the salon has become more than a place for hair care—it is a space for encouragement, wisdom, and meaningful conversation. Through her compassion, attentive listening, and faith, many have found hope, healing, and a deeper awareness of God’s love in everyday moments.

kurt-broadnax.name: Kurt Broadnax
kurt-broadnax.biography:
Before embarking on his ministerial journey, Kurt dedicated fifteen years to military service as an enlisted and non-commissioned officer. He also worked for a decade as a veteran service representative. He is academically accomplished and holds associate degrees in Air Conditioning and General Studies from Central Texas College. He is a graduate of the ministry program at Texas Southwest Jurisdictional School of Ministry, Church of God in Christ, located in San Antonio, Texas.

In the literary world, Kurt has penned thought-provoking works such as "Love Is An Action Word" and "Love is Love Can." His most recent publication, "Seasons of Life," guides readers through life's challenges and spiritual landscapes. Celebrating 29 years of marriage and acting as a spiritual parent, Kurt taps into his own reservoir of life experiences and spiritual wisdom to enrich his readers and congregation alike.

mack-hughley.name: Mack Hughley
mack-hughley.biography:
Mack Hughley experienced a spiritual awakening and was filled with the Holy Ghost on January 13, 2002. Soon after, he joined Pentecostal Determine COG, solidifying his commitment to his faith. From 2003 to 2005, Mack served faithfully as a deacon within the church. Feeling a divine calling, he stepped into ministry as a minister in 2006, preaching his first sermon in December of that year.

His dedication didn’t go unnoticed. In 2011, he was ordained an elder of Pentecostal Determine COG, assuming a vital leadership role. Throughout these years, he was not only a faithful armor-bearer and assistant to Bishop W.B. Hanna but also a committed student at the PDC Bible College Institute, where he was nurtured under the careful directorship and tutelage of Bishop W.B. Hanna.

maurche-reed.name: Maurche Reed
maurche-reed.biography:
Maurche Reed, a.k.a “Maurche the Dreamer,” published her first book, “I Am My Worst Enemy."

Maurche Reed is an inspirational speaker and author. She helps break barriers mentally by transforming your thoughts to renew your mind. She helps individuals to dream big and turn those dreams into reality. She speaks the word of God and encouragement around the world. She is dedicated full-time to bringing her message to conferences, meetings, workshops, and worldwide. As a keynote speaker or workshop leader, she breaks through the boundaries limiting your team. She helps transform ordinary people to become warriors.

rosetta-perry.name: Rosetta Perry
rosetta-perry.biography:
Rosetta Perry was born and raised in Youngstown, Ohio. She grew up in a loving Christian home and knew that she loved singing and acting, and making people laugh at an early age. Rosetta is the youngest sibling; she has a brother and a sister. She has one son and three grandsons. After graduation from her Alma Mater, Youngstown State University, she relocated to Columbus, Ohio, pursuing her passion for singing and acting.

Rosetta has acted on many stages around the country with Words 2 Life Drama Ministry and Stew Jacks Entertainment. She also performed in the 2014 Washington DC Urban Theater Festival. In addition, she has recorded two Gospel CDs and one live Comedy CD.

tekisha-wimbush.name: Tekisha Wimbush
tekisha-wimbush.biography:
Pastor Tekisha D. Wimbush is a Native of Cleveland, Ohio. She is a minister of the Gospel of Jesus Christ and the wife of Bishop Willie J. Wimbush Jr., Church of the Reform Church of Love in Cleveland, Ohio.

Lady Wimbush’s commitment to serving and helping others is evident through her lifestyle of service and dedication to the families and communities she serves. She diligently works with the Women’s Ministry at Church of the Reform Church of Love to promote unity and sisterhood. She frequently hosts prayer and Women’s Forum meetings, retreats, workshops, and other events to empower women to develop and grow in the love of God. In addition, Lady Wimbush serves in various ministries within The Church of the Reform, including Adult Sunday School Teacher, Church Finance/Administration Committee, Praise Team, Engagement / Program Coordinator, Youth Ministry, and Outreach.

terry-stephens.name: Terry Stephens
terry-stephens.biography:
Apostle Terry Stephens II is a powerful apostolic and prophetic leader used by God to usher in a fresh perspective concerning Kingdom government and leadership. His mission is to unite the body of Christ for the last days’ stand. He operates with a unique, revelatory anointing that focuses on breaking the chains of religion and tradition. With a military perspective, Apostle Stephens is passionate about fivefold-ministry leadership aligned with a Kingdom agenda.

While serving in the United States Army and deployed to Iraq, God began imparting the vision for Truth & Wholeness Ministries to Apostle Stephens. Guided by the Spirit of God, Truth & Wholeness Ministries aims to resemble the Army through cultural diversity, developing leaders, and establishing a distinct Kingdom culture. The ministry was founded in June 2011 and continues to grow and expand its reach.

thomas-johnson.name: Thomas Johnson
thomas-johnson.biography:
Bishop Thomas Lee Johnson, Sr. is a man after God’s own heart. He is dedicated to the work of the lord, knowing that his life is not his own. Therefore, he has submitted to the will and work of our most high God. Bishop is a native of Detroit, MI, where he was educated in the Detroit Public School system. He is a graduate of Chadsey High School (1965).

Later in life, he was inspired to further his education at Marygrove College. He also holds an honorary (DD) Doctor of Divinity degree from the Detroit Urban Bible College. Bishop Johnson met Jesus Christ on his personal road of Damascus in 1970 and received the baptism of the Holy Spirit shortly after. After faithfully serving under the leadership of his pastor, he was ordained as an elder in 1974. In 1975, he yielded to the call of God and established Immanuel House of Prayer Church. In 1994, he was found worthy of being elevated and ordained as a Bishop. Again, following the leading of the Lord in 2010.

will-harris.name: Will Harris
will-harris.biography:
Dr. Will Harris is a renowned singer, songwriter, musician, recording artist, and author. A native of Oxford, Mississippi, Harris began playing piano and singing in church at an early age and assumed his first Minister of Music role at just fourteen.

Dr. Harris currently serves as the Director of Music and Fine Arts at the Historic Metropolitan Baptist Church in Washington, DC.

jackie-smith-jr.name: Jackie Smith Jr
jackie-smith-jr.biography: Jackie Smith, Jr. is the founder of J Merrill Publishing, Inc. and the visionary behind J Merrill One. His work centers on helping authors protect their intellectual property, publish with excellence, and build platforms that outlast a single launch cycle.

leslie-banks.name: Leslie Banks
leslie-banks.biography: Leslie Banks, MSA, LCDC II, is a counselor, motivational speaker, author and adjunct professor. As a chemical dependency/mental health counselor, she specializes in working with young, African-American males. She uses sincerity, humor and genuine approach to touch the hearts and motivate the hard to reach and sometimes forgotten youths. Leslie earned a BA in Business Administration, a degree in counseling, and a Master’s degree in Health Services Administration and Human Resources. Leslie is the founder and CEO of L. Banks and Associates, LLC and the non-profit organization Mending Our Youth. Currently residing in Columbus, Ohio, she enjoys spending her time with her family, traveling, and being active in her church. She lives by the principal of 1 Thessalonians 5:11 “So encourage each other and build each other up, just as you are already doing.”

dennis-brown.name: Dennis Brown
dennis-brown.biography:
Dennis Brown writes from the heart of a teacher and pastor including a wealth of cross-cultural experience in Mexico, Papua New Guinea and earlier short-term ministries in the West Indies.

Dennis is a graduate of Fuller Theological Seminary’s School of International Studies (previously, School of World Mission) as well as Ohio Christian University (previously, Circleville Bible College).  He has also studied graduate level courses in Organizational Development (Azusa University) and Sociology (Texas A&M).

shana-byrd.name: Shana Byrd
shana-byrd.biography: She has devoted her life to working with pregnant and parenting youth by helping them obtain the tools to break the cycles of abuse and poverty. Her book, Focus, Trust, and Follow is a book of devotions that use some of her real life experiences to make God’s word relatable to others. It is her hope that those who read her book are inspired and encouraged to focus on God, trust His word, and Follow Him with reckless abandon.

edith-clay.name: Edith Clay
edith-clay.biography: Edith V. Clay came to Columbus with her parents. Graduated from West High School, and soon after married her husband John. They had two sons. John and Anthony. It was doing different times and situations in her life that God gave her words of inspirations that helped her as well as others.

deborah-eiland.name: Deborah Eiland
deborah-eiland.biography: Because of my love for books and reading, I have always thought about writing a children’s book.

pamela-smith.name: Pamela Smith
pamela-smith.biography: Pamela Smith is an Evangelist, Wife, Mother, and Spiritual Counselor to many. Her desire in life is to serve God and share His Word with all those she encounter s.

christina-banner.name: Christina Banner
christina-banner.biography:
Christina Has worked with children since she was a little girl herself! From directing The “Rosebud”choir at her childhood church, to working at daycares and coordinating her first Vacation Bible School! She has had a love for making children smile!

Christina is thankful for so many mentors along the way! And those yet to come!

brandyn-mcelroy.name: Brandyn McElroy
brandyn-mcelroy.biography: BRANDYN MCELROY is a corporate professional, community leader and minister, but most importantly, he’s a husband and father. Dealing with infertility is a challenge that can be daughting to anyone and Brandyn has devoted himself to informing and encouraging men on how to navigate this difficult path. While each journey bring forth different obstacles, faith and the pursuit of knowledge will guide you to better future for you and your partner.

shelley-mcintosh.name: Shelley McIntosh
shelley-mcintosh.biography: Dr. Shelley McIntosh earned her doctoral degree in curriculum and instruction at the University of Houston. Her research and studies have focused on the social, spiritual, and academic development of Black children; the spiritual voices of preservice teachers and their responses to state certification tests; the diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds of Black children; and biblical history. She has served as a bishop and cardinal, national youth director, professor of urban education, elementary school teacher, urban school principal, and English language arts coach.

janet-stephens.name: Janet Stephens
janet-stephens.biography: Janet Stephens (Lady J) is a leader, writer, exhorter, wife and mother of a blended family of 6 beautiful children. She partnered with her husband to plant Truth and Wholeness Ministries now Manifestation Church in Columbus, Ohio where she currently lives. She has developed a love for teaching the word of God and is passionate about everyone learning about their purpose in life, establishing a vision for their life, and walking in destiny. Lady J has served in many areas of ministry administratively, teaching, preaching and in song.
